name: project-assistant
description: Scan a workspace into an interactive code graph, chat with project context, and review agent-improvement policies from VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Project Assistant scans workspace source files, starts a local Python backend, and writes graph artifacts in the opened workspace.

selfEvolvingAgent.neo4j.uri.description: Neo4j Bolt URI used by the managed backend.

selfEvolvingAgent.neo4j.user.description: Neo4j username used by the managed backend.

selfEvolvingAgent.neo4j.database.description: Neo4j database used for graph seeding and retrieval.

selfEvolvingAgent.llm.provider.description: LLM provider used by the managed backend.

selfEvolvingAgent.llm.model.description: Agent LLM model used by the managed backend.

selfEvolvingAgent.telemetry.enabled.description: Whether to write redacted agent telemetry to local workspace storage.

selfEvolvingAgent.telemetry.externalJudg.description: Allow the background policy judge to send redacted turn telemetry to the configured external LLM.

selfEvolvingAgent.graph.autoRefreshOnSav.description: Automatically refresh the knowledge graph when files are saved.

selfEvolvingAgent.graph.jsonFileName.description: Name of the JSON file written to the workspace root after graph generation.

selfEvolvingAgent.graph.incrementalUpdat.description: When enabled, file edits patch the code graph and Neo4j incrementally instead of requiring a full rescan. Disable to fall back to manual full scans only.

selfEvolvingAgent.useMockBackend.description: When true, the extension serves mock data instead of calling the FastAPI backend. Useful for offline UI work.

selfEvolvingAgent.backend.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the managed FastAPI backend after setup.

selfEvolvingAgent.backend.pythonPath.description: Optional absolute path to the Python interpreter used to run the backend. Leave empty to auto-detect (prefers backend/.venv, then system python).

selfEvolvingAgent.graph.useLsp.description: Use the Language Server to resolve cross-file calls, imports, and inheritance. Requires the appropriate language extension to be installed and active (e.g. Angular Language Service, Pylance, built-in TypeScript).

selfEvolvingAgent.graph.analysisDepth.description: Controls how much CodeGraph detail is generated. Use flow/security only when you need local control-flow and data-flow nodes because they can greatly increase graph size.

selfEvolvingAgent.graph.includeAnonymous.description: Include nodes that could not be auto-named from context (shown as <anonymous@L#>). Disable for a cleaner architectural view.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:webview && npm run compile && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run copy-assets && npm run build:webview
